drain_route_contract.c_and_r: C is the monotonic control revision. R is the last route-changing control revision and may have gaps. A frozen Blue-to-Green switch alone advances R exactly E to E+1; drain, load, warmup and unload do not advance R.
drain_route_contract.crossover_effect: A Blue crossover keeps its served route source at the pre-switch route revision, observes the unique committed E to E+1 transition, and binds its durable effect plus independent readback to the latest actor-origin blue_drain_started row C=R+1/R with route_changed=false.
drain_route_contract.durable_binding: The effect write transaction and separate readback connection both lock and verify transition ID, route source, current lease ID/fencing hash, control/route revision, action, phase, weights, loaded identities and canonical payload hashes.
drain_route_contract.identity_and_reuse: Runtime response, terminal entity, causal event and durable receipt preserve exact request/trace/effect/model/version/artifact/result/route identity. Stale lease takeover, forged C/R, rollback/abort reuse and restart ABA remain fail-closed.
drain_route_contract.runner_gate: The runner validates both private causal projection and the complete success projection before returning an attempt. A crossover cannot complete after green switch until actor-origin blue_draining is committed and visible.
